title: discover.json: the head of one discovery, what it is about and where it stands
$comment: The coordinator writes it and sets `step` as each step opens. Everything else about the idea is in the records beside it.

idea.description: the idea in the user's words

appetite.description: what the user would waste if the idea is wrong

setting.description: internal: for the user's own organisation; external: for people outside it

brought.description: what the user brought with them, such as notes or links

coordinator.description: the agent that runs the discovery; the only one that writes items, changes, options, moves, briefs and decisions

step.description: the step the discovery is in, 1 to 10

handed.description: the brief handed on, to which skill, and when
